research_rationale:
EO:11653 (signed 1972-03-09; 37 FR 5115 (Federal Register of March 10, 1972)) is a single-command order. The order exempts Jack T. Stuart, United States Marshal for the Southern District of Mississippi, from compulsory retirement for age under subsection (c) of section 8335 of title 5, United States Code, until May 19, 1975. The order recites that he "reached the age of 70 on February 22, 1972" and would otherwise be subject to compulsory retirement after 60 days notice. Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing in jobs/fr-originals; its number, date and subject agree with the census register. Inventory: I confirm the dossier's one clause, which carries the recitals and the sole operative sentence; the text holds no other command, condition or proviso. The exemption ends by its own terms on 1975-05-19: the order's end date is quoted from the held text as "until May 19, 1975", recorded inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, that it ends when May 19, 1975 begins, is the alternative a reviewer should see (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on until-dates). Whether Stuart left office before the stated date is in no held source and is not asserted; the stated date is the latest day the exemption could operate. Searches, chosen after reading their coverage notes (all complete, none with a coverage warning): the U.S. Code search (release point 119-121, citations of the order by number in statute text and notes; edition current through 2026-10-09) recorded 0 hits; the eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML recorded 0 hits; the Federal Register catalog disposition-note search (1937 onward) recorded 0 hits for this order. I also searched every held order text (the Cruden held-text search, 33118 readable files) for the order's number; the only held texts that cite it are its own Federal Register printing. A held-text search of the person's name finds only that person's own exemption orders (this order) and unrelated matches.
